Defeating other players will now build up a Notoriety level. Accumulating too much Notoriety will trigger penalties.

2. Character Customization & Makeup
You can now visit the Beauty Salon to get a whole new you with the facial customization and makeup system.

3. Emotes & Director Mode
Unlock new emotes and Director Mode to upgrade your social interactions and record stunning in-game movies.

4. Expanded Language Support
Arabic, Indonesian, Thai, LATAM Spa
